fields.type: what kind of note this is
fields.status: where the note stands, such as draft or stable
fields.author: who wrote the note
fields.source: what the note is based on, usually a URL
fields.project: the project the note belongs to
fields.created: the date the note was created
fields.updated: the date the note last changed
fields.reviewed: the date the note was last checked
fields.expires: the date the note goes out of date
fields.due: the date the work in the note is due
fields.priority: how much the note matters, as a number
fields.description: a one-line summary of the note
